title: Hinss et al. 2021 — Open multi-session and multi-task EEG cognitive Dataset for passive brain-computer Interface Applications
description: This dataset provides multi-session, multi-task EEG recordings from 15 healthy participants for passive brain-computer interface research on mental workload estimation. Each participant completed two sessions with a resting-state condition and three difficulty levels (easy, medium, difficult) of the MATB-II task. Data were recorded with 62 active Ag/AgCl EEG electrodes and ECG, and are distributed here as a BIDS-formatted derivative generated with MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with an ActiCHamp amplifier (Brain Products) using 62 active Ag/AgCl electrodes in a 10-20 layout, referenced to Fpz, with an impedance threshold of 25 kOhm and an auxiliary ECG channel. Participants performed resting-state and MATB-II tasks at three difficulty levels across two sessions. Released epochs are 2 s long at 250 Hz.

funding_references.funder_name: ANITI (Artificial and Natural Intelligence Toulouse Institute)
